title: Chapter 02 — Gains from Trade
desc: Absolute vs comparative advantage, computing opportunity cost from output, specialisation and the terms of trade — two live models and a chapter quiz.
h1: Why the worse producer still gets the job
intro: The one chapter where the right answer offends common sense: a country that is worse at making everything still has something worth specialising in, and both sides end up with more. The arithmetic is short, and the exam tests it relentlessly.
